★ 4.92 · Guest Favorite

Sleeps 11Bedrooms 4Beds 6Baths 3.5

The rules that bite
  • Quiet hours 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM, noise monitored — warnings escalate, and repeat violations can end the stay
  • No parties or events
  • No smoking or vaping — $250 fine

House details

Pool table · theatre seats · canal views · fast Wi-Fi + dedicated office · free parking (garage + driveway) · in-home laundry · full kitchen · air conditioning. Hosted by Susan · Premier Stays · Superhost. Exact address lands in the group chat after booking.
